A little help for your daily build

Your blocks are a weekly pattern. Day, week and month views show that pattern on real dates. Checkmarks, checklists and journal entries are date specific.

  • 1 Day · 2 Week · 3 Month
  • N New block · T Today
  • / Search · ? This help
  • Ctrl/Cmd Z Undo · Ctrl/Cmd Shift Z Redo
  • Esc Close dialog

Shortcuts pause while typing. Undo holds the latest 30 changes for this visit. Export JSON for a complete backup. ICS exports the weekly template; CSV exports the filtered date range.

Amway products & calendar suggestions

A planning estimate, not a purchase or a guarantee of health benefits. Retail checked on Amway U.S. pages September 26, 2026. Your estimate of $4 retail = 1 PV puts this multi-month stock-up above 150 PV; confirm actual account PV before ordering.

ProductQtyEachTotal

Excludes taxes, shipping and can deposits. Quantities are future supplies, not a direction to increase daily intake. Buy only what you will use; discounts and product-specific PV can change the actual total.

How it fits your week

  • Monday & Wednesday: teach the kids 1:15–2:45 PM; rest 2:45–6:15 PM.
  • Thursday: work 3–8 AM and noon–3 PM; co-op 9 AM–12:30 PM. Arrange another adult for 11:30 AM–12:30 PM and pickup, assuming a 30-minute return commute. The overlap is intentionally visible.
  • Double X: optional adult use with two meals, following the label; first serving at weekday lunch or weekend breakfast, second at dinner.
  • Plant protein: optional breakfast top-up when useful; balanced meals and water remain the foundation.
  • Advanced Omega: optional, with one meal per day as labeled, if appropriate for your diet, allergies and medications.
  • XS: optional early-shift adult caffeine only. Each can has 114 mg; avoid at least five hours before sleep, longer if sensitive. Never use it to replace sleep or give it to children.

Review supplements with a clinician/pharmacist if you take medicines or have health conditions. Do not add overlapping multivitamins or extra servings to meet a PV goal. Your existing rest time is preserved.
